description: Source code implementing a simple token-based authentication mechanism for testing purposes in the etcd server, including token generation, validation, and TTL management.

classes.name: simpleTokenTTLKeeper
classes.description: Manages TTL for simple tokens, periodically deleting expired tokens.

classes.name: tokenSimple
classes.description: Provides simple token generation, assignment, validation, and management functionalities.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the TTL keeper, signaling it to terminate.

methods.name: addSimpleToken
methods.description: Adds a token with an expiration time.

methods.name: resetSimpleToken
methods.description: Resets the expiration time of a token.

methods.name: deleteSimpleToken
methods.description: Deletes a token from the TTL keeper.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the TTL management loop, deleting expired tokens.

methods.name: genTokenPrefix
methods.description: Generates a random token prefix string.

methods.name: assignSimpleTokenToUser
methods.description: Assigns a token to a user, panics if token is already used.

methods.name: invalidateUser
methods.description: Invalidates all tokens associated with a user.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables token management, starting TTL keeper.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables token management, invalidating all tokens.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves authentication info for a token, resetting TTL if valid.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a new token to a user based on context parameters.

methods.name: isValidSimpleToken
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid based on its format and TTL.

methods.name: newTokenProviderSimple
methods.description: Constructs a new simple token provider with specified logger, index waiter, and TTL.
